name: Jost's Engineering Company Limited
about: Jost's Engineering Company Limited manufactures and sells material handling equipment and engineered products in India. The company offers engineered products comprising sound and vibration, environment simulation, electrical test and measurement, heat and combustion products, components, electrical test and measuring instruments, nanotechnology, and analytical solutions, as well as connectors and switches. It also engages in the material handling rental business; and provision of on-site testing, technical training installation, erection, commissioning, calibration, annual maintenance contract, maintenance, and support services. The company was formerly known as Jost's Fan Supply and Engineering Company Limited and changed its name to Jost's Engineering Company Limited in 1913. Jost's Engineering Company Limited was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
